title: Global Site Settings

fields.label: Pesan WhatsApp Default

fields.instructions: Teks pesan yang otomatis terisi saat user klik tombol WhatsApp (opsional).
fields.placeholder: Halo, saya ingin bertanya mengenai villa...

sub_fields.label: Label / Teks
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.default_value: For press and media enquiries please contact us here

fields.label: Link Footer Bawah
fields.name: footer_links
fields.instructions: Daftar link yang muncul di bottom bar footer (Term & Conditions, Privacy Policy, dsb).

fields.label: Deskripsi Modal Kontak
fields.name: modal_contact_description
fields.default_value: Discover exclusive offers crafted to elevate your stay, from special rates to extended privileges.

fields.label: CF7 Shortcode
fields.name: modal_contact_form_shortcode
fields.instructions: Paste CF7 shortcode lengkap, contoh: [contact-form-7 id="abc123" title="popup form"]

description: Pengaturan global situs: kontak, social media, footer links, dan modal kontak.

fields.label: Page Builder
fields.name: page_builder
fields.instructions: Add components to build the page.

sub_fields.label: Section Gallery (Images)
sub_fields.name: section_gallery
sub_fields.instructions: 1 image = full width. 2 images = 50% grid. 3+ images = dynamic grid.

sub_fields.label: Descriptions
sub_fields.name: descriptions
sub_fields.instructions: Add 1 row for a single column description, 2 rows for a 2-column description, etc.

sub_fields.label: Link Text (Button Label)
sub_fields.name: link_text
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to auto-generate (e.g. from Page Title)

sub_fields.label: Stories
sub_fields.name: stories
sub_fields.instructions: Select posts to display as featured stories.

sub_fields.label: Selected Offers (Optional)
sub_fields.name: selected_offers
sub_fields.instructions: Select specific offers to display. If left empty, all Special Offers will be displayed automatically.

sub_fields.label: YouTube URL
sub_fields.name: youtube_url
sub_fields.instructions: Masukkan link YouTube lengkap, misal: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxxxx

sub_fields.label: Map Embed Code
sub_fields.name: map_embed_code
sub_fields.instructions: Paste Google Maps iframe src here

fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: card_description
fields.instructions: Description shown on the Grid Card.

fields.label: Terms & Notes
fields.name: terms_notes
fields.instructions: e.g. Recommended for bookings made 30-60 days prior.

labels.not_found_in_trash: No special offers found in Trash
